verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships an official Python package for writing scripts that control and extend the terminal (iterm2-docs-13). GitHub describes it as a full automation API for custom status-bar components, triggers, menu items and new features (iterm2-gh-15, iterm2-gh-12, iterm2-gh-2), and a community user praises using it in practice (iterm2-comm-13). AppleScript support adds a second official scripting surface (iterm2-docs-14). missing for 10: SDKs in languages beyond Python, evidence of in-depth API reference or versioning docs, and broader independent corroboration of building against the SDK.
